race.comment: BOSS BUNDLE (1) was coming back from Hong Kong first up at Sale and ran very well to grab a narrow third. Fitter for that and Shinn sticks. Fitter and should go close. SUMALUV (12) has been right there in two runs back and should be ready to peak. She draws well and should be running on strongly. MR SPENDEDOE (6) was well backed on debut at Geelong and showed speed when holding on for a good second. Better for that racing experience and can clearly improve here. MONSIEUR CLAUDE (5) is an entire by Lucky Vega for the Laurie yard who can run a good race. Worth monitoring for any market confidence.
